_comment: Hand-curated resolutions for Sharpless objects the positional pass flags
as possibly colliding with a raw-OpenNGC nebular row but that NO identifier
layer (SIMBAD NGC/IC/M, shared LBN/Ced cross-id, or an OpenNGC 'SH 2-n'
Identifiers entry) resolves. lib/sharpless_crosswalk.mjs FAILS LOUD if a
flagged object is missing here, or if an entry here is no longer flagged
(stale). resolution 'overlap': same physical object as `match` (an existing
OpenNGC row) — excluded from parsers/sharpless.mjs, which records the pair
so parsers/deepsky.mjs can merge the Sh2 alias onto the OpenNGC row instead.
resolution 'distinct': a real separate object — baked despite the proximity.
Curated against SIMBAD and the usual imaging literature.
common_names: display names for Sharpless-only objects (VII/20 has none and
SIMBAD NAME coverage is spotty — e.g. no 'Tulip').
overlap_common_names: fill-when-empty names for the EXISTING OpenNGC rows
the overlap pairs point at, applied by parsers/deepsky.mjs — an OpenNGC
'Common names' entry always wins; these only fill blanks (NGC 7380 has no
name in OpenNGC, so 'Wizard' was unsearchable). Keyed by Sh2 number like
everything else here. Entries whose target row is not in the bake are
inert and apply automatically if it later enters.
extra_designations: additional searchable ids for Sharpless-only rows that
no source supplies. SIMBAD keys these as separate objects and VII/20 has no
cross-reference column, so a designation in universal amateur use can exist
in neither — Sh2-108 IS the gamma Cygni / IC 1318 complex, but nothing in
the fetched sources links the two. Use sparingly and only where the id is
genuinely the same target; note the reasoning inline.

108.note: Sh2-108 is the gamma Cygni complex. OpenNGC resolves IC 1318 to the STAR gam Cyg (HD 194093) and types it '*', so the deep-sky bake drops it and the crosswalk — which only considers nebular-typed rows — never flags the pair. SIMBAD does model IC 1318 as HII ('NAME gam Cyg Nebula') but keys it as its own object 1.8° from the Sh2-108 centroid, so no identifier layer links them either. Same complex; IC 1318 B/C are lobes within it.

136.note: SIMBAD's main_id is GN 21.15.8 and it lists only [RK68] 107 alongside — no vdB id, though vdB 141 is what imagers call it. Note SIMBAD types this RNe (reflection), while the Sharpless bake types every row hii_region by rule.
